text:
Product Overview
PM3001GPR-W V1 is a 30W single-port long-distance waterproof PoE extensible developed by our company. This device provides 2 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 ports, in which the input port is connected to the PoE switch, and the output port is connected to the IP terminal equipment. The two extenders can be used with PoE switches (the input port is connected to the PoE switch) to extend the 1000M network data to 500 meters at most, without configuration, and plug and play.
Professional outdoor shell design, adapt to a variety of harsh environments, with high stability, reliability, industrial level, wide temperature. The whole machine does not need power adapter, convenient for harsh outdoor environment and indoor monitoring equipment that is not easy to take electricity.
Product Features
Support IEEE802.3af/at Standard;
Plastic housing, protection class IP67;
Capable of transmitting both data and power on a single network cable;
Support 10/100/1000Mbps data transmission;
1 PD receiving terminal ;
1 PSE supply terminal;
Plug-and-play, no configuration required;
Operating temperature:-10°C~55°C;
It's ideal for harsh outdoor environment.
Product Specifications
Model	PM3001GPR-W V1
Standard	IEEE802.3,IEEE802.3u,IEEE802.3x,IEEE802.3ab,IEEE802.3af,IEEE802.3at
Port	1*10/100/1000Mbps INPORT / 1*10/100/1000Mbps OUTPORT
Network Media(Cable)	10BASE-T: UTP category 3, 4,5 cable (≤100m) / 100BASE-TX: UTP category 5, 5e cable（≤100m） / 1000BASE-X:UTP category 5e,6 cable（≤100m）
Indicator	LNK/ACT: Orange for access port, green for extension port
Transfer Mode	Store-and-forward
Power Supply Mode	PoE power supply/pass through
PD Port Input	IEEE802.3af/at
PoE Power Output	IEEE802.3af/at
Input Voltage	PoE power supply 48~57V
PoE Power on RJ45	1/2(+)3/6(-)
Dimensions (L*W*H)	156.5*29*29MM
Operating Temperature	-10 °C ~ 55 °C
Storage Temperature	-40 °C ~ 70 °C
Operating Humidity	10% ~ 90% non-condensing
Storage Humidity	5% ~ 90% non-condensing
MTBF	>50000 hours
Weather Rating	IP67
